newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 7.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average rises for a second consecutive day to a new record of 7,225
* Lack of major corporate, political or economic news may keep trading subdued.
* On Tuesday, the Composite Index ignored Wall Street's rise and ended down 4.97 points at 1,090.
* "It is the lack of foreign interest in the market that is keeping a rebound from occurring," said Ralph Dixon at TA Securities' international division.
* Focus would continue to be on situational stocks which have some news or rumours to trade on, dealers said.

* Market still has no confirmation about the rumoured merger between MBf Capital and Suria Capital. MBf on Monday told the stock exchange it was not aware of any reason for the unusual activity in its shares.
* Some dealers said Affin Holdings could get some attention also on rumours that it was seeking to either merge with or acquire another financial company after its ongoing equity issues.
* Paracorp PCBD.KL will list on Wednesday.
